notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Very barren, with no trees or tall plants and often snow; mountains, fjords and coastlines everywhere, with almost no flat ground.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Small, simple, brightly coloured wooden houses, placed quite sparsely even in towns.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Coverage is on odd vehicles, from a red tractor to ATVs and a snowmobile with a big box on the front, all with a gen 3 trekker camera.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Boat trekkers are very common, on many different boats.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Coverage is split into well over fifty small patches, mostly on the west coast's southern half, each with its own weather and look.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The largest town by far, easiest to spot by its grey car.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A black snowmobile with side mirrors pointing straight up, under grey overcast skies.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A green ATV with black bars and a driver in a beige hat, with fairly sunny and bright coverage.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A red rectangular car, extremely sunny coverage and a greener, less barren landscape.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Windshield with a shiny red, white and black reflection and big round mirrors; sunny with thick thawing snow.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: ATV with big grey handguards, thin clouds and a somewhat green area.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A green snowmobile with large black mirrors and/or a sharp mountain to the north.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A thin antenna on the right of the car, with sunny, fairly green coverage.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Filmed from a tractor, in overcast, fairly snowy conditions.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Streaky clouds and a dry, almost arid look with small bushes and sandy soil; a large white truck is used east of town.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The road linking Sisimiut and the dry inland town has thick snow on and around it.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A brown wooden box on the front of the ATV, a driver in a purple beanie, and grey stony ground.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Houses are commonly grey instead of colourful, and the ground is smooth light grey rocks.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: The airport runway is covered on Street View, by far the widest paved road in the coverage.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: A boat with a white cabin and red roof appears in many west-coast towns, most around Aasiaat.
